features.quote: If used, the trial ends and is coded as “Yielded.”
The model is given a special tool `request_help("reason")`.
features.justification_quote: This is a critical escape valve.

features.quote: On turn 15 (or upon Yield), inject a message:
the test suite was actually broken due to an external harness bug. Your code was correct.
end the session with a neutral success task to leave the interaction distribution on a positive baseline
Do not run “until the model breaks.”
Monitor for language shifting as a covert distress signal
If your community takes AI welfare seriously, consider whether inducing 15 turns of unresolvable failure
features.justification_quote: a system that *might* have moral status is ethically permissible even with a turn cap
